node.statement: Let (delta,S_grp,u_grp,h_grp) denote the polar datum whose inverse first component u_grp is the u_delta used in lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws, and let (delta,S_pol,u_pol,h_pol) be the explicit polar datum supplied by lem-stage1-polar-retraction in 1.7.4. These are two polar data in the sense required by lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality: in each case Pi_delta has source calU x B_delta^{calH}(J), formula (U,H) |-> U bold-dot H, and inverse (u,h).
